correctness.rationale: The stationary four-mark chain is irreducible for \(\rho<1\); the harmonic stochastic convolution is unique, and orientation reset independently kills two-time memory after a tumble. The exact moment generator closes at fourth degree and reduces to the stated cumulant. A separate four-state rational stationary linear solver passed 1,347 exact checks including thermal contributions, both sides of the sharp sign boundary, and the exact threshold witness. Gaussian thermal convolution leaves fourth cumulants invariant. Endpoint \(\rho=1\) is excluded from uniqueness.

value.rationale: A physically motivated Markov memory mechanism leaves the entire active-force covariance and stationary position variance invariant but crosses a sharp and exactly attainable negative-to-positive fourth-cumulant boundary. This distinguishes hidden propulsion-amplitude memory from independent speed renewal and remains valid with independent thermal noise. The exact threshold is a natural structural invariant rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
